title: Global-Regularized Neighborhood Regression for Efficient Zero-Shot Texture Anomaly Detection (GRNR)
mechanism: Training-free: each patch is regressed from its in-image neighbours, regularised by global normal prototypes from the same image.
adaptation: Per-cell prior for multi-crystalline texture; the periodic cell layout (fingers, busbars) makes in-image neighbours good references, including for unseen half-cut layouts. Offline only.
evidence: R: eight benchmark datasets, beats some trained methods without any training data.
min_experiment: Offline map on CV val + F51 multi cells; kill if < 30% of PF-missed crack components >=20 px recovered at 1% area.
